blocking_findings.title: Terminal admission lineage does not match the persisted materialization outcome
blocking_findings.cause: persist_local_qualification_bundle serialized result.materialized while LocalQualificationTerminal was constructed from result.admitted; the verifier used at run creation did not parse or cross-check the materialization, theorem, variant, representation, or screening records
blocking_findings.required_correction: Persist and bind the pre-screening materialization as the canonical materialization outcome, point terminal.materialization_outcome_id to it, and add a separate smoke-only admission dry-run receipt for derived pair/NLLean IDs. The verifier must parse and cross-check every record.

blocking_findings.title: The archived input bundle does not bind the code that orchestrated qualification
blocking_findings.cause: The nonexistent-repository replay uses the currently imported verifier implementation. It proves archived data-input integrity but cannot identify the exact execution semantics that generated, materialized, represented, screened, and persisted the run.
blocking_findings.required_correction: Bind an immutable content-addressed qualification code bundle and its ID/hash into QualificationInputBinding, LocalQualificationTerminal, and bundle verification.

blocking_findings.title: Benchmark and duplicate screening is recorded but not self-contained or recomputed by replay
blocking_findings.cause: The preflight and screening records bind a registry hash, but the qualification bundle does not archive the registry/index bytes and verify_local_qualification_bundle trusts the persisted screening record.
blocking_findings.required_correction: Archive the exact active registry/index and the prior-candidate identity index, reconstruct screening during replay, and require exact equality with the persisted screening record.

important_hardening.title: The exact local model snapshot lacks a compact file-hash manifest
important_hardening.observed: The run binds AI-MO/Kimina-Autoformalizer-7B at ddd47cb477d93b3ca990468e1c0d5ad6b60973dd, four metadata hashes, and the expected total checkpoint bytes. At audit time all four local safetensor shards matched their content-addressed Hugging Face blob names.
important_hardening.required_correction: Bind a compact exact snapshot manifest covering weight shards, model index, tokenizer.json, tokenizer config, special tokens, vocab, and merges. Weight bytes need not be copied into the run bundle.

important_hardening.title: Several derived records have no intrinsic smoke marker
important_hardening.observed: Every record is individually rejected by the current release guard because it is smoke or lacks explicit production eligibility. Materialization, representation, screening, qualification-input, and bundle records do not themselves carry artifact_class=smoke.
important_hardening.required_correction: Make the bundle and dry-run receipt explicitly smoke-only and require downstream training/release joins to the terminal/bundle lineage so a generic production wrapper cannot launder an unmarked derived record.

required_verifier_invariants: Parse and canonical-byte validate every manifest record, not only terminal, call, attempt, and qualification inputs.
terminal.materialization_outcome_id equals the persisted pending-screening outcome ID.
The persisted pending outcome has semantic_pool_eligible=false, pair_ids empty, nl_lean_id null, and screening_id null.

A smoke AdmissionDryRunReceipt binds pending outcome, screening, theorem, representation, deterministic dry-run admitted outcome, pair IDs, and NLLean ID while hard-coding every scientific eligibility flag false.
The terminal references the dry-run receipt rather than presenting dry-run IDs as persisted admissions.
Theorem, variant, representation, screening, call, problem, context, parser, raw response, and generation hashes agree transitively.
The archived registry and prior-candidate index recompute the persisted screening record exactly.
The manifest contains no PairRecord, NLPLeanRecord, ResolvedLabel, annotation, or semantic-evidence artifact.
The archived qualification code bundle and exact model snapshot manifest match their terminal/input bindings.
